title: Delay Modeling with Conformable and Caputo Derivatives: Analytical and Computational Insights
summary: This work presents an analytical and computational study of fractional-order delay differential equations formulated using both the conformable and Caputo derivatives. For the conformable case, we develop the associated integral, exponential function, and Laplace transform, showing how the conformable Laplace framework preserves algebraic structure and facilitates explicit solutions. Delay terms are treated through series expansions and transform-based methods, ensuring causal and finite representations. In parallel, Caputo-based formulations are examined, highlighting the challenges posed…
